summary: Backend testing of SpotYou participation system with PostgreSQL transactions, SELECT FOR UPDATE concurrency safety, and real-time WebSocket broadcasts. All 40 tests PASS (19 existing + 21 new).

critical_code_review_comments: All new SpotYou routes use proper async transactions (conn.transaction()) — OK
SELECT FOR UPDATE on tag_points in going_spot_you correctly prevents capacity race conditions — OK
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on spot_you_members INSERT correctly handles concurrent joins — verified with async concurrent test
spotyou_manager (ConnectionManager) is shared across spot_you_routes.py and chat_routes.py via single import — OK
WebSocket /ws/spot-you/{point_id} correctly authenticates via first JSON message with 5s timeout — OK
asyncio.create_task() for broadcast is called AFTER transaction commit — correct pattern to avoid dead locks
websockets v15 deprecated ConnectionClosed.code — use Protocol.close_code instead. Only affects test warnings, not production code.
